phase_objective: Collect at least two new strict-success scripted trajectories whose ordered arm-assignment pattern is right-left-left, while preserving the source reset sampler and every simulator, controller, safety, capture, and task-success invariant.

single_intervention.name: right_first_rll_reset_stratum_seed_allocation

historical_basis.falsification: If the exact predeclared RLL pool yields fewer than two new strict-success captures, terminate as insufficient and do not materialize a dataset or train.

seed_selection.selection_rule: Scan every integer seed from 1051 through 1250 before any Genesis execution. Select the first 16 seeds in ascending order whose source-compatible reset produces exactly right-left-left. Attempt every selected seed once in the frozen order and admit every strict success.

changed: training seed allocation is conditioned on the preexecution right-left-left arm-assignment stratum
unchanged: source reset sampler and source reset distribution
ascending-Y bowl ordering and x-sign arm assignment
Mantis URDF, bowl assets, table, cameras, planner, controller, collision rules, timing, and action mapping
probe calibration and exact-plan replay capture
strict stability, safety, stage-trace, and source-hash admission gates
evaluation seeds, ACT architecture, optimizer, and training hyperparameters

per_candidate: static source-reset pattern recomputes as exactly right-left-left before launch
probe process exits zero and writes a hash-linked valid replay plan
probe has exactly 12 strict stability rows and zero safety failures
exact-plan replay capture exits zero and writes a nonempty NPZ
capture stage trace is complete with eight completed task stages and no failure stage
capture has exactly 12 strict stability rows and zero safety failures
accepted placement pattern is exactly right-left-left
NPZ, stage trace, receipt, and capture manifest exist and independently hash

claim_boundary: This phase can establish a source-compatible, right-first scripted training-trajectory stratum and its immutable source identities. It cannot establish dataset readiness, learned-policy improvement, G3 passage, generalization, AMD/ROCm execution, performance advantage, hardware validity, or real-robot safety.
